description: Practical analyses, examples, and official SDK stubs for ExteraGram 12.5.1+ / AyuGram plugins (Python, Chaquopy, Xposed-style & partial hooks, Elyx, multi-account).
rules: This repo contains practical examples, plugin analyses, and comprehensive SDK references/stubs for exteraGram/AyuGram plugin development.
Target environment: exteraGram 12.5.1+ (intents 12.6.4+), Python 3.11 (Chaquopy), SDK 1.4.4.3+ / 1.4.6.x (stable & beta builds from exteraSquad/plugins-pysdk-builds).
Always consult for-agent/SKILL.md and stubs/ for exact API definitions, multi-account scoping rules (self.client(account)), logging (self.logger), and Elyx multi-file structures.
Class and method names can change between app versions (R8), so verify them against target Telegram sources or decompiled exteraGram.
